name: 95202 · Stockton, CA
findings: ZIP 95202 (Stockton) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95202 (Stockton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95202 (Stockton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.0 times the typical level).
